title: [France] train_s1: shape, null rates, length distribution
headline: The France slice in train_s1 is EMPTY. country_rows has no France key at all. France train share is exactly 0 of 2206821. Every France rate requested in this work order is UNDEFINED (0/0), not 0%.

france_train_s1.arithmetic: country_rows has only US=1323633 and India=883188; 1323633+883188 = 2206821 = rows exactly, so the breakdown is complete and France is absent, not zero-valued.

all_requested_france_stats.reason: Each is f(France)/rows(France) with rows(France)=0. 0/0 is undefined. Reporting any of these as 0% would be fabrication, and reading them as a measured rate is exactly the error behind the retracted '100% of France rows resolve a state' figure.

code_confirmation.implication: stage-2 crossfit is hard-coded to two countries; France is never trained on. Line 122 concatenates cf_best_{c} over the same tuple.

code_confirmation.code: the country has no training labels (e.g. France in the test set)
code_confirmation.implication: label-free France is handled by rule (b) decoy post-filtering by prior, not a learned per-country threshold

measured_contrast.note: Rates are f/by_country[c].rows. France column is test_s1, the only France population that exists.
observations: France mean name length 19.4229 is 3.0 chars shorter than US 22.4651, the nearest train country.
France mean addr length 50.0709 is 43 percent longer than US 34.9624.
France dig5/row 0.00417 reproduces the already-checked 0.004 figure; no conflict, not re-derived.

name_length_histogram_train_s1.key_semantics: len_hist key = int(len(business_name)//10*10), a NAME length floored to tens

field_semantics_from_build_profile_py.num_digits: digits in the ADDRESS only (line 114, sum over ba). Raw digit COUNT, not rows, not name. Not used for any headline figure.
field_semantics_from_build_profile_py.dig5_dig6: lookaround-guarded regex (?<!\d)\d{5}(?!\d) and (?<!\d)\d{6}(?!\d), lines 29-30. A digit inside a longer digit run does NOT count.
field_semantics_from_build_profile_py.has_digit_name: separate ROW count, any digit in business_name (line 106). This is the digit-in-name field used above.
field_semantics_from_build_profile_py.has_comma: tests the RAW address string for a comma (line 108), not the split components.
field_semantics_from_build_profile_py.prefix_bad: rows where entity_id does not start with 'S{src}-' (line 94). train_s1 has source=1 so the guard is 'S1-'. Measured 0 for US, India and France test_s1.
field_semantics_from_build_profile_py.per_country_stats: totals across the whole slice; all rates derived by dividing by that country's rows.
field_semantics_from_build_profile_py.name_tokens_addr_tokens: top 4000 per country AND periodically pruned (prune(), PRUNE_EVERY=8), so counts are lower bounds. Absence means 'not in the top 4000', never 'does not occur'.
field_semantics_from_build_profile_py.flattening: ADDR_SPLIT=[,;] then TOKEN_RE per component (lines 126-127), so a token count is not automatically a pipeline-visible quantity.

sufficiency_to_conclude.france_train: UNDEFINED, not a negative result. No slice means no n and no confidence interval; no France train conclusion is available at any n because n=0.
sufficiency_to_conclude.us_india_train: Overwhelming (1.32M / 0.88M rows). SE on the US 2.6060 percent digit-in-name rate is sqrt(0.02606*0.97394/1323633) = 0.0138pp; India's is 0.0037pp. As firm as the dataset permits.
sufficiency_to_conclude.france_test_s1: 259,452 rows, ample for its own descriptive stats; this is exactly the population the retracted 100 percent figure mis-scoped to.

gaps: Genuinely not measurable: any France TRAIN rate. Data gap, unfixable from the provided files.
Genuinely not measurable: France train name_tokens/addr_tokens tables; the keys are absent.
INFERRED not measured: that the name-length gap implies France is uncalibrated. The means are measured; the consequence is inference.
alpha_only_addr not queried for France test_s1.
not_rederived: RETRACTED French function-word 15.41 percent finding (real 10.25, mechanism self-cancelling)
new_defect_note: No defect. prefix_bad=0, name_empty=0, addr_empty=0, and both len_hist bin sets reconcile exactly to rows. The only carry-forward is the denominator warning, a reporting-discipline hazard, not a code defect.
denominator_warning: ANY France rate computed against a train-file France denominator is meaningless. This is the exact error that produced the retracted '100% of France rows resolve a state' figure. Check the denominator before accepting any France train statistic.
